title: Why Smart Decisions Can Still Lose (Annie Duke's Poker Rule)
alt_title_1: The 'Resulting' Bias Silently Ruining Your Strategy
alt_title_2: Life Is Poker, Not Chess (Thinking in Bets Explained)
description_hook: World Series of Poker champion Annie Duke explains why judging your choices solely by their immediate outcome - a cognitive trap called 'Resulting' - causes smart builders to abandon winning strategies right before they pay off.

scenes.headline: When an 80% Smart Bet Still Loses Today
scenes.stat_label: TIMES AN 80% FAVORITE STILL LOSES IN THE SHORT RUN
bullets: Good odds never guarantee a win on try number one
Quitting after one loss destroys long-term edge
scenes.narration: You can make an eighty-percent-smart decision today, watch it fail tomorrow morning, and ruin your future by assuming your strategy was wrong.

scenes.headline: Annie Duke & The 'Resulting' Bias
scenes.stat_label: HIGH-STAKES POKER LAB BEHIND 'THINKING IN BETS'
bullets: Poker pros separate decision quality from lucky cards
Amateurs equate every bad outcome with a bad plan
scenes.narration: In Thinking in Bets, World Series of Poker champion Annie Duke warns against a mental trap called Resulting: judging the quality of a decision purely by its short-term outcome.

scenes.headline: Outcome Quality vs Decision Quality
scenes.left_body: Ran red light safely -> 'great move' • 1 flop -> quit
scenes.right_body: Judge logic before outcome • Repeat smart bets 50x
scenes.narration: Running a red light blindfolded and arriving home unharmed is still a terrible decision. Likewise, shipping a smart project that flops once can still be a winning bet.

scenes.headline: Score Process Across 50 Iterations
scenes.stat_subtext: Short-term variance fades as smart process compounds
scenes.narration: Life is poker, not chess, because luck and hidden information sit at every table. Write down your reasoning beforehand and test positive-odds habits across fifty reps.

scenes.headline: Never Quit a Good System on Sample Size 1
scenes.stat_label: MINIMUM RUNWAY TO JUDGE YOUR PROCESS
bullets: Log your thesis before seeing the market's reaction
Protect high-upside habits from short-term noise
scenes.narration: Separate your daily process from single noisy outcomes, because in the real world, even when the math favors you...
